title: Head summary of a configuration
statement: For a configuration of a machine on a fixed Boolean input, its head summary consists of its optional state and the value obtained by applying the output-summary encoding to its output string and then mapping that summary to one of three values.
caveat: The definitions of the output-summary encoding and the map to three values are not included, so their meanings cannot be specified more precisely from the supplied statement.
